nodes.label: Softree Logo Animation - Tree Emerging from Split Sphere
nodes.description: Animation sequence (frames 004-080) showing a 3D rendered green tree with glowing blue roots emerging from a cracked black geometric sphere splitting open symmetrically on a dark background. The sphere halves open outward revealing the tree at center. Produced with Veo. Represents Softree brand identity concept of technology and nature merging.
nodes.motion_description: Sphere halves split and open outward while tree and luminous roots are revealed at center
